figure_title: Baseline MAPE by model and cold-start window

figure_title: Augmented MAPE by augmentation ratio and cold-start window
suggested_caption: Mean MAPE under statistical continuation augmentation. Larger augmentation ratios generally produce higher errors.

research_message: Identifies where statistical continuation augmentation helps or hurts.

figure_title: Improvement rate by model and augmentation ratio
suggested_caption: Fraction of paired comparisons in which augmented MAPE was lower than baseline MAPE.
research_message: Shows that augmentation improves only a minority of comparisons.

suggested_caption: Mean MAPE difference by sector and augmentation ratio. Positive values indicate degradation under augmentation.
research_message: Compares sector-level degradation while keeping augmentation ratio separate.

figure_title: Distribution of baseline and augmented MAPE
suggested_caption: Boxplots compare the distribution of baseline and augmented MAPE by augmentation ratio, excluding plotted outliers for readability.
research_message: Shows distributional shift rather than only average change.
